Behind The Veil is a Belgian melodic metalcore band formed in 2020 during the COVID‑19 period. The group is known for its dual female vocalists, Delphine De Vusser and Sofie Foster, whose contrasting vocal styles — bright versus dark — create a distinctive dynamic.
After several lineup changes and the release of two independent singles in 2023, the band gained recognition by winning the audience award at Metalworks Fest (2020) and later at Mentalfest (2025).
